title: Flight safety with physics-verified dynamics: a drone that says what is wrong with it
description: A 1.5 kg quad-X with four BEMT rotors, a pack that sags and a cascaded controller flies while eight faults are injected at t = 8 s, one per flight: payload, degraded motor, chipped blade, gust, GPS glitch, magnetometer interference, IMU vibration and battery sag. The Newton-Euler residual of the nominal vehicle is measured against the IMU and the pack telemetry, the direction of the residual names the fault, and three detectors are tuned to the same false-alarm budget before their detection delays are compared.
